title: Merlin (bird)
blurb: The merlin is a small species of falcon from the Northern Hemisphere, with numerous subspecies throughout North America and Eurasia.
facts: Males typically have wingspans of 53–58 centimetres (21–23 in), with females being slightly larger.
They are swift fliers and skilled hunters, which specialize in preying on small birds in the size range of sparrows to doves and medium-sized shorebirds.
